lines.say: Thank you for calling. Can I take your account number, your date of birth, and the first line of your address?
lines.zh: 感謝您的來電。請給我您的帳號、出生日期，還有地址的第一行。

lines.say: Sorry… my what?
lines.zh: 抱歉……我的什麼？

lines.say: Phone calls are the hardest English there is. You can't see a face, and you can't point at anything.
lines.zh: 講電話是最難的英文。看不到臉，也沒辦法用手比。

lines.say: My electricity bill was over two hundred euro too high, and I waited two months before I rang. I was too scared of the call.
lines.zh: 我的電費多算了兩百多歐，我拖了兩個月才打電話，因為我太怕講電話了。

board.cta: 打電話處理帳單出錯・12 句

lines.say: Hi everyone, I'm Neev! Today: twelve sentences to fix a wrong bill on the phone.
lines.zh: 哈囉大家，我是 Niamh 老師！今天教十二句話，打電話把算錯的帳單處理好。
lines.cap: Hi everyone, I'm Niamh! Today: twelve sentences to fix a wrong bill on the phone.

lines.say: You'll explain the problem, ask them to fix it, and write down the proof.
lines.zh: 說明問題、請對方更正，並且留下紀錄。

scenes.title: Get through
scenes.sub: 接通：說明來意，掌握節奏

lines.say: Part one: get through.
lines.zh: 第一段：接通之後。

lines.say: Before you ring, put three things in front of you: your account number, the bill, and a pen.
lines.zh: 打之前，先把三樣東西放在面前：帳號、帳單、一支筆。

scenes.label: No. 1
scenes.phrase: I'm calling about a problem with my latest bill.
scenes.meaning: 我打來是因為最新一期帳單有問題
scenes.note: I'm calling about ＝ 我打來是為了

lines.say: I'm calling about a problem with my latest bill.
I'm calling about is how almost every phone call starts.
lines.zh: I'm calling about 幾乎是每一通電話的開場。

lines.say: Your latest bill is the newest one, the one you just received.
lines.zh: latest bill 是最新的那一期帳單。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: I'm calling about a problem with my latest bill.

scenes.label: No. 2
scenes.phrase: Could you bear with me while I find my account number?
scenes.meaning: 可以稍等我一下嗎？我找一下帳號

lines.say: They'll ask for details. If you need a moment, don't go silent. Say this.
lines.zh: 對方會問資料。如果你需要一點時間，不要沉默，說這一句。

lines.say: Could you bear with me while I find my account number?
You know bear with me from our café lesson. Here it buys you time on the phone.
lines.zh: bear with me 在咖啡店那一課學過。在電話上，它能幫你爭取時間。

lines.say: Silence on the phone feels very long. One sentence makes it comfortable.
lines.zh: 電話上的沉默感覺特別久，一句話就能讓氣氛自在。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: Could you bear with me while I find my account number?

scenes.label: No. 3
scenes.phrase: Sorry, you're breaking up. Could you say that last part again?
scenes.meaning: 抱歉，你的聲音斷斷續續，最後那段可以再說一次嗎？
scenes.note: you're breaking up ＝ 訊號斷斷續續

lines.say: And if you don't understand, blame the line, not your English!
lines.zh: 如果你聽不懂，就怪訊號，不要怪自己的英文！

lines.say: Sorry, you're breaking up. Could you say that last part again?
You're breaking up means the sound keeps cutting out.
lines.zh: you're breaking up 是聲音斷斷續續。

lines.say: And ask for that last part only. Then they repeat one piece, slowly, not everything.
lines.zh: 只請對方重複最後那段，這樣他會慢慢講那一小段，不會全部重來。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Sorry, you're breaking up. Could you say that last part again?

scenes.title: Explain it
scenes.sub: 說明：用數字講，不用情緒講

lines.say: Part two: explain the problem.
lines.zh: 第二段：說明問題。

lines.say: The agent talks to angry people all day. Be the calm one with the numbers.
lines.zh: 客服整天都在面對生氣的人。你要當那個冷靜、有數字的人。

scenes.label: No. 4
scenes.phrase: I've been charged three hundred and twenty euro, which can't be right.
scenes.meaning: 我被收了三百二十歐，這不可能是對的
scenes.note: I've been charged ＝ 我被收了

lines.say: I've been charged three hundred and twenty euro, which can't be right.
I've been charged is passive. You're not saying you did this. You're saying this happened.
lines.zh: I've been charged 是被動語態。你沒有說「是你害的」，只說「事情發生了」。

lines.say: And which can't be right adds your opinion in a calm way.
lines.zh: which can't be right 則是冷靜地補上你的看法。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: I've been charged three hundred and twenty euro, which can't be right.

scenes.label: No. 5
scenes.phrase: My bills are normally around ninety euro.
scenes.meaning: 我的帳單通常在九十歐左右

lines.say: Then give them something to compare it with.
lines.zh: 接著給對方一個比較的基準。

lines.say: My bills are normally around ninety euro.
Normally means usually. Around means approximately.
lines.zh: normally 是通常，around 是大約。

lines.say: Now the agent can see the problem in five seconds.
lines.zh: 這樣客服五秒鐘就看得出問題。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: My bills are normally around ninety euro.

scenes.label: No. 6
scenes.phrase: It looks like the meter reading was estimated.
scenes.meaning: 看起來電表度數是用估的
scenes.note: It looks like ＝ 看起來像是　estimated ＝ 估算的

lines.say: If you know the reason, say it carefully.
lines.zh: 如果你知道原因，要小心地說。

lines.say: It looks like the meter reading was estimated.
A meter reading is the number on your electricity meter. Estimated means they guessed it.
lines.zh: meter reading 是電表上的數字，estimated 是公司用猜的。

lines.say: It looks like is softer than you made a mistake. It lets them agree with you easily.
lines.zh: It looks like 比「你們弄錯了」柔和，對方很容易就能認同你。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: It looks like the meter reading was estimated.
Listen to the middle of the call.
lines.zh: 來聽通話的中段。

lines.say: I've been charged three hundred and twenty euro, which can't be right. My bills are normally around ninety euro.
lines.zh: 我被收了三百二十歐，這不可能是對的。我的帳單通常在九十歐左右。

lines.say: I see. Let me have a look at the account.
lines.zh: 了解，我看一下您的帳戶。

lines.say: It looks like the meter reading was estimated.
lines.zh: 看起來電表度數是用估的。

lines.say: You're right. It was estimated. Have you got the actual reading there?
lines.zh: 沒錯，是估算的。您手邊有實際的度數嗎？

lines.say: Numbers first, then the reason. She found it straight away.
lines.zh: 先講數字，再講原因，她馬上就找到問題。

scenes.title: Get it fixed
scenes.sub: 要求更正：講清楚你要什麼

lines.say: Part three: get it fixed.
lines.zh: 第三段：要求更正。

lines.say: Many callers explain the problem beautifully, and then never say what they want.
lines.zh: 很多人把問題說明得很好，卻從頭到尾沒說自己要什麼。

scenes.label: No. 7
scenes.phrase: Could you issue a corrected bill?
scenes.meaning: 可以重新開一張正確的帳單嗎？

lines.say: Could you issue a corrected bill?
To issue a bill means to produce it and send it.
lines.zh: issue a bill 是開立並寄出帳單。

lines.say: It's a formal word. Use it, and the agent knows you're serious.
lines.zh: 這是正式的字。用了它，客服就知道你是認真的。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Could you issue a corrected bill?

scenes.label: No. 8
scenes.phrase: I'd like the difference refunded to my account.
scenes.meaning: 我希望差額退回我的帳戶
scenes.note: the difference ＝ 差額　refund ＝ 退款

lines.say: If you already paid, ask for your money.
lines.zh: 如果你已經繳了，就要把錢要回來。

lines.say: I'd like the difference refunded to my account.
The difference is the extra amount you paid. Refunded means paid back.
lines.zh: the difference 是你多付的金額，refunded 是退還。

lines.say: They may offer credit on your next bill instead. It's OK to say you'd prefer a refund.
lines.zh: 對方可能會說折抵下一期帳單。你可以說你比較想要退款。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: I'd like the difference refunded to my account.

scenes.label: No. 9
scenes.phrase: How long will that take to come through?
scenes.meaning: 那大概要多久才會入帳？
scenes.note: come through ＝（款項、文件）下來、到達

lines.say: And always ask for a time.
lines.zh: 而且一定要問時間。

lines.say: How long will that take to come through?
When a refund comes through, it arrives in your account.
lines.zh: come through 是款項進到你的帳戶。

lines.say: Five working days is an answer. Soon is not an answer.
lines.zh: 「五個工作天」是答案，「很快」不是答案。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: How long will that take to come through?

scenes.title: Keep a record
scenes.sub: 留紀錄：名字、編號、覆述一次

lines.say: Part four: keep a record.
lines.zh: 第四段：留下紀錄。

lines.say: If nothing happens, you'll have to ring again. Make sure the second call is short.
lines.zh: 如果事情沒處理，你得再打一次。要確保第二通電話很短。

scenes.label: No. 10
scenes.phrase: Could I take your name and a reference number?
scenes.meaning: 可以請問你的名字和案件編號嗎？
scenes.note: take your name ＝ 記下你的名字

lines.say: Could I take your name and a reference number?
Could I take your name means: please tell me your name so I can write it down.
lines.zh: Could I take your name 是請對方報名字，讓你記下來。

lines.say: A reference number is the number of this call. With it, the next agent can see everything.
lines.zh: reference number 是這通電話的編號，有了它，下一位客服什麼都查得到。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: Could I take your name and a reference number?

scenes.label: No. 11
scenes.phrase: So, just to recap: you'll send a new bill, and refund the difference.
scenes.meaning: 所以整理一下：你們會寄新帳單，並退回差額
scenes.note: just to recap ＝ 整理一下重點

lines.say: Before you hang up, say it all back.
lines.zh: 掛電話之前，把內容覆述一遍。

lines.say: So, just to recap: you'll send a new bill, and refund the difference.
To recap means to repeat the main points.
lines.zh: recap 是把重點再說一次。

lines.say: If you misunderstood something, this is when you'll find out, not in two weeks.
lines.zh: 如果你有聽錯，現在就會發現，而不是兩個星期後。

lines.say: Your turn!
lines.zh: 換你！

lines.say: So, just to recap: you'll send a new bill, and refund the difference.

scenes.label: No. 12
scenes.phrase: If it hasn't come through by Friday, who should I ask for?
scenes.meaning: 如果星期五前還沒入帳，我該找誰？
scenes.note: who should I ask for ＝ 我該指名找誰

lines.say: And one last clever question.
lines.zh: 最後一個聰明的問題。

lines.say: If it hasn't come through by Friday, who should I ask for?
Ask for someone means say their name when you ring.
lines.zh: ask for someone 是打電話時指名找某人。

lines.say: It tells them, very politely, that you will be checking.
lines.zh: 這句話很有禮貌地告訴對方：你會回來追蹤。

lines.say: Now you say it!
lines.zh: 換你說！

lines.say: If it hasn't come through by Friday, who should I ask for?
Could you issue a corrected bill? And I'd like the difference refunded to my account.
lines.zh: 可以重新開一張正確的帳單嗎？還有，我希望差額退回我的帳戶。

lines.say: Certainly. I'll do both now.
lines.zh: 沒問題，我現在兩件一起處理。

lines.say: How long will that take to come through?
lines.zh: 那大概要多久才會入帳？

lines.say: Three to five working days.
lines.zh: 三到五個工作天。

lines.say: Could I take your name and a reference number?
lines.zh: 可以請問你的名字和案件編號嗎？

lines.say: It's Priya, and your reference is four, four, seven, nine.
lines.zh: 我叫 Priya，您的案件編號是 4479。

lines.say: Done. And I had everything on paper.
lines.zh: 搞定，而且我全部都記在紙上。

scenes.title: Only in Ireland
scenes.sub: 愛爾蘭限定：電話上的兩個習慣

lines.say: One more thing! Two things about Irish phone calls.
lines.zh: 還有加碼！愛爾蘭人講電話的兩個習慣。

lines.say: Here, people often say ring, not call.
lines.zh: 這裡的人常說 ring，不說 call。

lines.say: I'll give you a ring tomorrow.
No jewellery, sorry. It just means I'll phone you.
lines.zh: 抱歉，不是送你戒指，只是我會打給你。

board.kicker: The Irish goodbye on the phone

lines.say: And Irish people never say goodbye once on the phone. It's more like this.
lines.zh: 愛爾蘭人掛電話從來不只說一次 bye，而是像這樣。

lines.say: OK, thanks a million. Bye. Bye, bye, bye, bye.
If you say bye just once and hang up, it feels a bit cold. So join in!
lines.zh: 如果只說一次 bye 就掛，會有點冷淡。一起來吧！

lines.say: Bye, bye, bye, bye!

scenes.title: All together
scenes.sub: 總複習：三分鐘講完一通電話

lines.say: Let's make that call again, the calm way. Say my lines with me!
lines.zh: 我們用冷靜的方式重打一次。跟我一起唸！

lines.say: Thank you for calling. How can I help?
lines.zh: 感謝您的來電，有什麼需要協助的嗎？

lines.say: I'm calling about a problem with my latest bill.
lines.zh: 我打來是因為最新一期帳單有問題。

lines.say: Can I take your account number?
lines.zh: 請給我您的帳號。

lines.say: Could you bear with me while I find my account number?
lines.zh: 可以稍等我一下嗎？我找一下帳號。

lines.say: Of course. Take your time.
lines.zh: 當然，慢慢來。

lines.say: So, just to recap: you'll send a new bill, and refund the difference.
lines.zh: 所以整理一下：你們會寄新帳單，並退回差額。

lines.say: That's right. Is there anything else?
lines.zh: 沒錯。還有其他需要嗎？

lines.say: If it hasn't come through by Friday, who should I ask for?
lines.zh: 如果星期五前還沒入帳，我該找誰？

items: I'm calling about a problem with my latest bill.
Could you bear with me while I find my account number?
Sorry, you're breaking up. Could you say that last part again?
I've been charged three hundred and twenty euro, which can't be right.
My bills are normally around ninety euro.
It looks like the meter reading was estimated.
Could you issue a corrected bill?
I'd like the difference refunded to my account.
How long will that take to come through?
Could I take your name and a reference number?
So, just to recap: you'll send a new bill, and refund the difference.
If it hasn't come through by Friday, who should I ask for?

lines.say: You did it, and you didn't even need to see a face.
lines.zh: 你做到了，而且連臉都不用看。

lines.say: Here are all twelve. Screenshot them, and keep them beside you when you ring.
lines.zh: 十二句都在這裡。截圖下來，打電話時放在旁邊。

board.cta: 打開 BinBin，每天用一則新聞練英文

lines.say: I'm Neev. Open BinBin, and practise English with one news story every day.
lines.zh: 我是 Niamh 老師。打開 BinBin，每天用一則新聞練英文。
lines.cap: I'm Niamh. Open BinBin, and practise English with one news story every day.

lines.say: See you next time. Bye. Bye, bye, bye, bye!
lines.zh: 下一課見。Bye，bye bye bye bye！
